Regarding Submission Documents for “Foreign Language (English)” for the AY 2027 Entrance Examinations (Conducted in AY 2026)
[Acceptance of TOEIC Score]
For the Graduate School Entrance Examinations for the Master’s Program and Doctoral Program (conducted in AY 2026 for admission in AY 2027), our department plans to accept TOEIC scores in addition to TOEFL as submission documents for the “Foreign Language (English)” requirement.
For detailed and official information, please refer to the Guide to Entrance Examination for the Department of Chemical System Engineering, which will be released at a later date.
